note: HAND-LABELED groundedness for the metastore GDWIKI oracle. Groundedness = "does the passage the answer cites actually support an answer to the query". A LIVE-LLM judge panel is out of scope for this deterministic slice, so each query carries three HAND-LABELED judge scores (0-2) plus a one-line justification, curated offline against the ranked citations `keryx wiki ask` returns (captured in wiki-ask-results.json). The scorer feeds these three scores through benchmark.ts `judgePanel`: strict groundedness = all three judges score 2, lenient = at least two of three. This mirrors the metrics-and-validation.md judge-panel protocol; a live-LLM 3-judge panel is a documented FOLLOW-UP and would replace only these scores (identical panel shape), not the scorer. `target` matches the query in wiki-gold.json; `scores` are the three judges; `justification` is the audit note. NEVER regenerated by the producer script.
judge: hand-labeled (3 scores 0-2 per query); live-LLM judge panel is a follow-up
